section_1.title: Prerequisite Intuition: The Vector Space
section_1.content: Briefly define a vector as an arrow in 2D space. Introduce the concept of 'scaling' and 'adding' vectors as geometric movements (tip-to-tail).
section_1.example: A robotic arm moving 2 units East and 3 units North.

section_2.title: Linear Combinations and Span
section_2.content: Explain that a linear combination is the result of scaling vectors and adding them together. 'Span' is the set of all possible destinations reachable by varying these scale factors.
section_2.example: Visualizing two vectors as 'basis' directions: combining them covers the entire 2D plane like a grid.

section_3.title: Linear Dependence: Redundancy
section_3.content: Introduce linear dependence visually: when a third vector lies on the same line or plane as the others, it adds no new 'reach.' It's redundant information.
section_3.example: Three hikers: If hiker A and B are walking on the same trail, hiker C (who is just following them) is linearly dependent.

section_4.title: Basis: The Minimalist Framework
section_4.content: Define 'Basis' as the smallest set of vectors that span the entire space without any redundancy (linearly independent). This is the 'minimal coordinate system' for the space.
section_4.example: Using standard basis vectors (1,0) and (0,1) to describe the location of a pixel on a digital screen.

section_5.title: Synthesis and Summary
section_5.content: Wrap up: Span defines the 'reach,' Linear Dependence checks for 'redundancy,' and Basis provides the 'perfect frame.'
section_5.example: A GPS system needing exactly 3 satellites (a basis) to pinpoint a coordinate in 3D space.

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(f"- {line}", font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 1.5 + j * 0.8
                y = 2.0 - i * 0.8
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = ["Linear combinations scale and add vectors.", "Span is every reachable destination.", "Varied factors create a grid."]
        self.setup_layout("Linear Combinations and Span", lecture_lines)
        
        # Define vectors
        u = Vector(RIGHT * 1.5 + UP * 0.5, color="#33FF57")

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Linear Dependence: Redundancy", ["Dependence reveals redundant directions.", "A third vector adds no reach.", "Like hikers following one trail."])
        
        # Setup vectors
        u = Arrow(start=ORIGIN, end=RIGHT*1.5, color=BLUE).shift(self.grid["D2"])
        v = Arrow(start=ORIGIN, end=UP*1.5, color=GREEN).shift(self.grid["D2"])
        w = Arrow(start=ORIGIN, end=(RIGHT+UP)*1.5, color=RED).shift(self.grid["D2"])
        
        u_label = MathTex("u", color=BLUE).next_to(u.get_end(), RIGHT, buff=0.1)
        v_label = MathTex("v", color=GREEN).next_to(v.get_end(), UP, buff=0.1)
        w_label = MathTex("w=u+v", color=RED).next_to(w.get_end(), UP+RIGHT, buff=0.1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(YELLOW))
        self.play(Create(u), Write(u_label), Create(v), Write(v_label), Create(w), Write(w_label))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE), self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(YELLOW))
        self.play(FadeOut(w), FadeOut(w_label))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(WHITE), self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(YELLOW))
        self.play(Indicate(u), Indicate(v))
        self.wait(2)
